correctness.rationale: Squarefree basis monomials multiply to x_{S union T} for disjoint S,T and zero for intersecting supports. Linear zero-product tensor identities join all nonempty ordered disjoint splittings of each U via incomparable subsets; multiplication sends the common class to independent x_U for |U|>=2, yielding (J tensor J)/Z2(J) isomorphic to J². Every A_r element with nonzero constant is a unit, so nontrivial zero products have both operands in J; the three unitization tensor components remain unconstrained and give K⊕J⊕J⊕J². Dimensions and symmetric condition L=R follow exactly. Independent GF2 rank enumeration for r=1,2,3 matched full zero-product span; unrestricted proof holds for all K.

final_claim: For every field K and r>=1, the nonunital squarefree nilpotent radical J_r=(x_1,...,x_r) in K[x_1,...,x_r]/(x_i^2) is zero-product determined despite nilpotency index r+1. The universal zero-product bilinear tensor quotient for the unitization A_r is K direct-sum J_r direct-sum J_r direct-sum J_r^2; dimension 3*2^r-r-2, multiplication defect 2^(r+1)-r-2, symmetric defect 2^r-r-1 (zero only r=1), yielding the asserted finite-field counts.
